status_legend.partial: Basic version in place; missing pieces noted

features.title: Per-vertex color triangles for soft gradients
Main loop + game-state machine
features.note: Has PLAYING/LANDED/CRASHED; missing WAITING start screen and GAMEOVER/win.

features.title: Starfield background
features.note: Static screen-space stars only (parallax starfield deliberately dropped).

features.title: 1/r^2 gravity
features.note: Sums over every body, the star included.

features.title: Coast trajectory prediction
features.note: Predicted with the planets advancing along their orbits, drawn in the frame of the strongest-pulling body; a ghost ring marks where another world will be at closest approach.

features.title: Hull heat / re-entry burn / burn-through crash
Planet orbits (kinematic + gravity-driven)
features.note: Kinematic circular orbits, Kepler-consistent with the parent mass: planets around the star, moons around planets. Ships share a planet's orbit (star gravity), drag acts in the planet's frame, landing speed is judged relative to the body. Gravity-driven (integrated) orbits + eccentricity still todo.

features.title: Atmosphere shell + Rayleigh/Mie arc-ring shader
features.note: Fullscreen shader pass, per-planet scatter colors (PlanetLook). Day/night comes from orbiting the star. Horizon haze band + soft-fading limb. Sun lens-flare not ported.

features.title: Surface texture (snow caps / rock by altitude)
features.note: Live in the body shader pass: five per-planet tones by altitude + slope lighting from the SDF gradient. (Water is its own pass: see water.)

features.title: Sea level + water rendering + underwater state
features.note: One water level per wet world, set so a share of the ground lies under it: the low ground fills into ponds, lakes and seas (temperate, jungle, ice, most exotic worlds, the odd desert waterhole; volcanic and airless worlds are dry). Drawn behind the crust in three flat depth tones with a pale far strip of surface, a slow swell and glints; whatever is in it is tinted, and the lake bed shows through. The ship floats on it (lands, bobs, lifts off); the astronaut sinks slowly, walks the bottom, swims up with jump and treads water, dives with S. Dug space floods only where it connects to water, up to the level. The home drop-in point is always dry land; mesas and plants keep out of the water. Not yet: lava or frozen seas, anything living in the water, currents or draining.

features.title: Parallax background ridge silhouettes
features.note: Six haze-tinted layers per world with per-archetype tints; the near framing plane is a screen-anchored band (drawForeground).

features.title: FBM cloud shader layer
features.note: Fullscreen shader pass: FBM density in a low-altitude band, Beer's-law opacity, sun-direction shading, gentle drift.

features.title: Multiple planets + moon + sun
features.note: Generated from a seed (system_gen): star + 4-6 planets + moons, seven archetypes with their own palette/sky/clouds/terrain/gravity, generated names. All shader passes multi-planet; destructible fields are lazy (nearest body only, digs replayed).

features.title: Other worlds + the star on the sky dome
features.note: Port addition: true direction, real relative size, lit half toward the star; they rise and set behind the terrain.

features.title: Altitude-based framing
features.note: One rule ground-to-space: the true ground under the player stays in frame the whole way up and down; horizon on the lower third when grounded.

features.title: Overview/system map mode (M)
features.note: M frames every orbit around the star; orbit rings, world markers and DOM name labels also fade in whenever the view is far out.

features.title: Plant (growable, abductable)
features.note: Grass and bulb plants grow on the ground strip around the walking line, in depth (in front of / behind the walker); cut with the mining laser for carbon, and they grow back. Not abductable by the ship.

features.title: Mineral (intact/abductable)
features.note: Rocks (ferrite) and crystals on every world, ore only on airless ones; mined with the laser, slow to come back. Not abductable by the ship.

features.title: Ground aliens (the locals)
features.note: Port addition, well past decorative: every world has its own kind of people, drawn from its seed (skin color, size, one to three eyes, three body plans, antennae, a glass bubble helmet on airless worlds), in the world's crystal color for what they wear. One keeps each trading post's stall; one to three more wander beside it, stop to look at you, and the trader waves when you walk up. Not abductable.

features.title: Fuel burn + out-of-fuel handling
features.note: Burn rate is a debug knob (0.05/frame: a tank reaches orbit and a neighbor world); the tank refills while landed.

features.title: Deliver cargo at base + refuel
features.note: No base: cows in the hold are sold to any trader instead (150 credits on the home world, one and a half to two times that anywhere else), which empties the hold for more. Refuelling is still free while landed.

features.title: Trading posts: sell to and buy from the locals
features.note: Port addition. A few posts on every world (hut, stall, lantern mast), one always a short walk from the home drop-in point; the HUD points to the nearest. E beside the trader opens a panel: sell what you carry (one, all of a kind, or everything) for credits at that post's prices, buy upgrades, buy goods. A world's own crystal is cheap there and worth about three times as much on other kinds of world; each post is short of one thing and says so; a post's goods are its world's crystal and a local staple from a stock that does not refill. The cutter will not dig under a post. Credits and upgrades are lost with the run on a crash restart.

features.title: Upgrades / shop (fuel, beam, cargo)
features.note: Bought from the traders with credits, in levels: fuel tank (+30% a level, 4), jetpack cell (+40%, 3), laser focus (+40% mining speed, 3), cutter coil (+35% digging speed, 3), cargo bay (+1 cow, 3). No beam upgrade; the terrain cutter itself is still unlocked from the start rather than bought.

features.title: Body discovery on approach
features.note: Worlds are charted on approach (+25) and on first landing (+100); HUD shows the current world, type, system and chart progress.

features.title: Inventory (Tab) + pickup feed
features.note: Slot grid with icons, counts and descriptions; carbon, ferrite, one named crystal per kind of world, and the cave items (calcite, glowcap, gold). No capacity limit or transfer. Everything in it can be sold to the traders; it has no other use yet.

features.title: Mesas + natural cave systems
features.note: Flat-topped mesas on every rocky body; most hold a cave system cut into the dig layer: flared mouth, gallery, hall (skylight or through-passage), ramp or well down to a deep cavern, crystal grottos, sometimes a geode room. Furnished with minable stalactites/stalagmites/columns, glowing crystals, glowcaps and gold veins that light the cave walls; mouths have uneven rims, a lit far wall and rubble. Nothing marks caves on the map yet.

features.title: Buried ore
features.note: Clumps of ferrite, the world's crystal and gold seeded through the rock of every rocky world (deeper = more gold; per-world bias; rich and barren stretches). Ore stops the terrain cutter: it halts at a clump and reveals it, chips glitter near hidden ones, and the mining laser takes it out a piece at a time (gold nuggets, ferrite cubes, crystal shards; one item per piece, progress kept), leaving a pocket that shows the next clump of the vein. Holding the cutter on a clump heats it red and, after about three times its mining time (oreBurn knob), burns it away with nothing collected. Finds and losses show in the pickup feed. The cutter no longer gives ferrite by itself. Not yet: a scanner to find ore through the rock; the caves' gold veins are still separate props.

features.title: Terrain cutter (aimed, person-scale digging)
features.note: Second mode of the hand tool (Q). Small bites where the beam meets rock on a fine carve layer; the astronaut collides with the rock itself, so shafts and tunnels can be walked into, and cows drop into a hole cut under them. Holes open at the walking line with an elliptical mouth; from the surface the front ground covers the shaft, down a hole it becomes a see-through cutaway. Cut rock scorches and glows, with embers and smoke. Yields ferrite. The ship still lands on the terrain outline only.

features.title: Click-to-zap laser
features.note: Reworked as the astronaut's mining laser: hold the mouse button to fire at the cursor; harvests plants/rocks/crystals in front of and behind the walking line. The ship has no laser.

features.title: Time-scale control slider
features.note: Would make the long coasts between worlds painless (time warp).

features.title: Thruster flame
features.note: Particle/vector flame; original also has fluid plume.

features.title: Tractor beam visuals (gradient cone, stripes, dust, splat)
Far-view blinking ship beacon
features.note: Port addition for the zoomed-out view.

features.title: Ground blob shadows under ship/astronaut/cows
features.note: Port addition: sun-offset soft ellipses fading with altitude.

features.title: Far-view heading arrow (while steering)
features.note: Port addition.

features.title: Water splash particles
features.note: Spray when the ship or the astronaut goes into water and where exhaust hits it, rings round a floating hull or a swimmer, bubbles from a submerged helmet, jetpack or cutter.

features.title: Live debug tuning panel (localStorage)
features.note: Core knobs plus fuel burn/refuel, horizon haze, foreground band, vignette, camera horizon; seed display, "New random system", per-world warp buttons.

features.title: Objective + nearest-body + event messages
features.note: Current world / type / system / charted count + event banners. No objective or nearest-body pointer yet.
